What team and personal mean 1

What do team and personal mean for a setting?

Recommended: A team setting comes from the committed AFK file when the repository has one, and your files cannot override it there. Only in a repository with no committed file does setup ask you for it and keep it in your personal file. A personal setting lives only in your own files; a committed value for it is ignored with a warning. If a repository gains a committed file later, setup lists your copies of team settings and offers to delete them. — This replaces the round-2 answer that made every forge and tracker setting private, and it settles the team-settings question: a team setting is never copied while the team file exists, so nothing can fall behind. It keeps your reason for privacy: a repository whose team does not use AFK needs no committed file, and nothing of yours is shared.
